english:
Melee and Sword Hits <void Weaken /> enemies for 6 seconds while you have an active void buff: <void Devour />, <void Invisibility />, or Overshield.

The void buff is checked when the hit lands, not when the attack is used.

Melee or Sword Kills while a void buff is active trigger a Weakening Burst that <void Weakens /> enemies within 4 meters for 6 seconds.

This has a 0.1 second cooldown between triggers.

source.text:
While a Void Buff (Devour, Invisibility, or Overshield) is active:
Melee and Sword Hits inflict Weaken for 6 seconds.
Checks on-hit, instead of snapshotting on-usage.

On Melee or Sword Kill while a Void Buff is active:
Triggers a Weakening Burst, inflicting Weaken to enemies within 4 meters for 6 seconds.
Incurs a 0.1s cooldown between triggers.
